toegepas.blok: Werk wat al honderde jare aanhou
toegepas.rede_vinder: Two adjectives of equal value before a noun are separated by a comma (AWS).
toegepas.fout: Two coordinate adjectives of equal value stand without the separating comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Glad and rond describe the stone equally, so the AWS comma belongs between them and nothing else changes.

toegepas.blok: Werk wat al honderde jare aanhou
toegepas.voor: Mense maak vandag nog kleipotte, en vandag nog mandjies uit gras.
toegepas.na: Mense maak vandag nog kleipotte en mandjies uit gras.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The second part has no subject or verb of its own, so the comma before 'en' is wrong under AWS, and the repeated 'vandag nog' reads wooden.
toegepas.fout: A comma stands before 'en' between parts of one sentence, and the repeated 'vandag nog' reads wooden.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal removes a comma the house rule forbids and the clumsy repetition, and keeps both crafts and 'vandag nog'.

toegepas.voor: Nat klei is sag en jy vorm dit
toegepas.na: Nat klei is sag, en jy vorm dit
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'en' joins two sentences each with its own subject and verb, so AWS requires a comma.
toegepas.fout: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb without the required comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two full clauses; no wording changes.

toegepas.voor: Die klei het ander eienskappe gekry en die pot is nou
toegepas.na: Die klei het ander eienskappe gekry, en die pot is nou
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'en' joins two sentences each with its own subject and verb, so AWS requires a comma.
toegepas.fout: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb without the required comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two full clauses; no wording changes.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'By ... bygemeng' repeats 'by' awkwardly; 'Vir hierdie stene' states clearly which bricks the mix is for.
toegepas.fout: 'By hierdie stene ... bygemeng' can read as if the sand is mixed onto the bricks, and the doubled 'by' jars.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Vir hierdie stene' names the same sun-dried bricks and the same mixing step, but reads more clearly.

toegepas.voor: Die steen kraak dan baie minder maklik wanneer hy droog word.
toegepas.na: Die stene kraak dan baie minder maklik wanneer hulle droog word.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The previous sentence speaks of 'hierdie stene' in the plural, so the singular 'Die steen ... hy' breaks the reference.
toegepas.fout: The singular 'Die steen ... hy' breaks the reference to the plural 'hierdie stene' in the sentence before.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The plural matches its antecedent without changing the claim or its qualifier 'baie minder maklik'.

toegepas.voor: Die hele dak lê skuins en die droë halms
toegepas.na: Die hele dak lê skuins, en die droë halms
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'en' joins two sentences each with its own subject and verb, so AWS requires a comma.
toegepas.fout: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb without the required comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two full clauses; no wording changes.

toegepas.voor: Mense kies meestal die materiaal vir wat sy eienskappe kan doen.
toegepas.na: Mense kies 'n materiaal meestal oor wat sy eienskappe kan doen.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'kies vir wat' copies English 'for what'; Afrikaans chooses 'oor' something, and 'n materiaal' is the general case meant here.
toegepas.fout: 'Kies vir wat sy eienskappe kan doen' copies English 'choose for what', and 'die materiaal' has no antecedent.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Kies 'n materiaal meestal oor' keeps who chooses, the basis of the choice and 'meestal', in natural Afrikaans.

toegepas.voor: en word hard in die vuur.
toegepas.na: en word in die vuur hard.
toegepas.rede_vinder: In Afrikaans the complement 'hard' naturally stands at the end, after the place phrase.
toegepas.fout: 'Word hard in die vuur' follows English word order.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Afrikaans puts the predicative 'hard' after the place phrase, so 'word in die vuur hard' is the natural order with the same meaning.

toegepas.voor: Die eienskap kom eerste en die gebruik volg daaruit.
toegepas.na: Die eienskap kom eerste, en die gebruik volg daaruit.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'en' joins two sentences each with its own subject and verb, so AWS requires a comma.
toegepas.fout: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb without the required comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two full clauses; no wording changes.

laat_vaar.voor: Bakstene begin ook by nat klei.
laat_vaar.na: Bakstene begin ook as nat klei.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'begin by' means start at a place; 'begin as' is the natural way to say bricks start out as wet clay.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Begin by' (the process starts from wet clay) is natural Afrikaans, while 'begin as' says the brick is wet clay at first, which fits badly with the sand and straw added a sentence later.

laat_vaar.voor: Groen halms krimp later in die mandjie.
laat_vaar.na: Groen halms sou later in die mandjie krimp.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The sentence gives the reason for drying first; 'sou' makes clear it is what would happen to green stalks, not what happens to the dried ones in the basket.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original states plainly what green stalks do, and that already gives the reason for drying; 'sou' turns a fact into a hypothetical and adds nothing a Grade 5 reader needs.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Singular 'palmblaar' used as a mass noun reads unnatural; the plural is the usual form.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Palmblaar' used as a mass noun names the material, which is natural; the plural suggests whole leaves and shifts what is described.

laat_vaar.voor: Vir baie matte bind gare die halms langs mekaar vas.
laat_vaar.na: Vir baie matte word die halms met gare langs mekaar vasgebind.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Making the thread the subject that ties is wooden; the passive with 'met gare' is the natural construction and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Thread as the subject that ties is acceptable Afrikaans, and the proposed passive is longer and no clearer for a Grade 5 reader.

laat_vaar.na: is sterker as een halm alleen.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'enige halm' can be read as any stalk at all, including those in the mat; 'een halm alleen' says clearly a single loose stalk.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Sterker as enige halm' is natural and clear in context; the proposal rewords a comparative claim without a real fault to fix.

laat_vaar.voor: hou daardie nat buitekant ver van die binnekant af.
laat_vaar.na: hou daardie nat buitekant weg van die binnekant.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'iets weg hou van' is the natural idiom for keeping something away; 'ver van ... af hou' reads stiff.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Ver van ... af hou' is idiomatic Afrikaans and 'ver' carries the distance the thick layer gives, which 'weg van' drops.

vlae.teks: Die lang dun stingel ... / 'n Hoë grasagtige plant met lang dun stingels ...
vlae.rede: By the same AWS rule as 'gladde, ronde klippie', these glossary definitions would take a comma between equal adjectives ('lang, dun'); not proposed as changes because these terms may be shared with other lessons, so a person should decide it subject-wide.

vlae.teks: 'n Hoë grasagtige plant met lang dun stingels wat mense verwerk.
vlae.rede: 'wat mense verwerk' can attach to the stems or to the plant; fixing it would mean guessing which is meant, and the definition may be shared.

vlae.teks: Die halms lê in dik lae op mekaar. ... Die dik laag hou daardie nat buitekant ...
vlae.rede: The text moves from plural 'lae' to singular 'Die dik laag' and 'die hele laag'; it reads as the thatch as a whole, but a writer should confirm the number is intended.
